notes.title: October 27th Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Added Dailies:[/b]
[list]
[*] There's a new [b]Daily Menu[/b] [i]("D" keyboard shortcut; "Select/Options" for controller)[/i] which presents you with a small Peach Tree that you have to water every day for 7 days!
[*]  On the 7th day, when the tree has [b]fully grown[/b] and you water it again - you get a [b]random[/b] Peach Skin [i](Normal or Common rarity, 50% chance for either)[/i] and the tree reverts back to a small sapling
[*] You can only water the tree [b]once per day[/b] [i](even if you forget to water it - you don't lose your progress)[/i]
[*] The daily menu features a number of different states [i](backgrounds)[/i]:
[list]
[*] Normal Day (40% chance) - no effects
[*] Rainy Day (40% chance) - you don't need to water your tree, it gets watered automatically when you open the Daily Menu
[*] Sunny Day (20% chance) - you get +1 to your day counter, which allows you to get +2 to your day counter if you also water
[/list]
[*] If you enter the game after [b]7 PM (UTC)[/b] you will be presented with the [b]night variants[/b] of the backgrounds:
[list]
[*] Normal Night (40% chance) - no effects
[*] Rainy Night (40% chance) - same as Rainy Day
[*] Starry Night (20% chance) - if you are at your 7th day and water the tree to get your skin, instead of getting a random Normal or Common skin, you get the [b]special Star Peach skin[/b], which can only be acquired through the daily
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Fixed UI scaling issue when in [b]Windowed mode[/b] and resizing the window

[*] [b]Added new Peach Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*] Star Peach - acquired only through Daily when Starry Night is visible
[*] Baby Peach (Normal)
[*] FRÖG Peach (Rare)
[*] Candle Peach (Halloween Event)
[*] Harry Peach (Halloween Event)
[*] Hockey Mask Peach (Halloween Event)
[*] Jack-o'-lantern Peach (Halloween Event)
[*] Magic Crystal Peach (Halloween Event)
[*] Scream Peach (Halloween Event)
[/list]
[*] [b]Halloween Event (10/28 - 11/04):[/b]
[list]
[*] During this week you can get a special category of Peach skins called [b]Event[/b], which includes 6 new skins
[*] On Halloween [i](10/31)[/i] only these 6 special skins will be dropped. [b]No other Peach skin will be available![/b]
[*] For the duration of the Halloween Event, backgrounds have been changed to match the vibe of the season
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: September 7th Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a [b]Sort Inventory[/b] button to stack same skins for a nicer Inventory
[*] Added [b]hotkeys[/b] for Inventory (I) and Settings (S) as well as the option to navigate Inventory pages with the Arrow keys
[*] Added new achievement [b](1,000,000 Clicks)[/b]
[*] Added new option to [b]change game background[/b] if the achievement for it is unlocked (Settings window)
[*] [b]Added Controller Support:[/b]
[list]
[*] "X" or "A" to smack Peach
[*] Triggers to smack Peach
[*] "Triangle" or "Y" to open Inventory
[*] "B" or "O" to close/exit
[*] "Options" or "Start" to open Settings
[*] "D-pad" and Analog Sticks for navigation
[/list]
[*] [b]Added a Leveling System:[/b]
[list]
[*] You get XP every time you smack the Peach
[*] On the bottom of the screen, below the CPS, there is an XP Bar which shows you how much XP you currently have, what Level you are on and how much you need to Level Up!
[*] Every [b]5 levels[/b] you get a Special Peach, which can only be acquired by Leveling Up!
[list]
[*] Level 5 - Copper Peach
[*] Level 10 - Silver Peach
[*] Level 15 - Gold Peach
[*] Level 20 (Max Level) - Diamond Peach
[/list]
[*] These 4 Peaches can be traded and sold, but there is no other way to get them (unless you buy them from someone on the Marketplace of course)
[/list]
[*] [b]Added Mini Peaches:[/b]
[list]
[*] Every [b]15 minutes[/b], a random chance roll is performed, which has a [b]50% chance[/b] to spawn a Mini Peach. This means that if you're really lucky - you can get a total of 12 Mini Peaches in the timespan of 3 hours (the time required for a skin drop). If you get a lucky roll - another roll is performed and there's a [b]50/50 chance[/b] if you'll get a Time Peach or an XP Peach. It will stay on your screen for [b]15 seconds[/b]. If you manage to click the Mini Peach before it disappears, you get the following:
[list]
[*] Time Peach - minimum 15 to maximum 30 minutes shaved off your Drop Timer
[*] XP Peach - minimum 1000 to maximum 2000 XP added to your Level
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: August 24th Update Notes
notes.content:
- [b]Fixed issue with skins not dropping for some people![/b]
- Due to popular demand, we made the game work in [b]idle mode[/b]! That means that you can leave it running in the background and the Drop Timer will keep going [b]down[/b]!
[b]It's important to note that you need to click the Peach at least ONCE when the timer is at zero in order to get your drop![/b]
- Changed the flashing light on background change to a smooth fade
- Added a [b]Settings[/b] menu, where you can change your game [b]Resolution[/b], adjust [b]volume settings[/b] and switch between Fullscreen and [b]Windowed[/b]
- Changed the drop pool to [b]3 hours[/b] to stimulate the skin prices, as they won't be dropping as often anymore!

We value your feedback, our Sweet Peaches, so make sure to let us know about any and all bugs and/or suggestions you have for the game! You can also join our official Discord Server to stay in touch with us and all other Peaches!
[b]We are here to listen to all your feedback and make Peach Clicker better, together! 🤗🍑[/b]
